text:
Maya (PM): Quick note — simulator sometimes shows old rule order if you drag and immediately run it. Repro: create 3 rules, move #3 to top, click Run.

Ben (Eng-UX): I can repro. We're reading DOM order; React batching causes stale reads.

Alice (Design): Users expect immediate consistency. Suggest a tiny shimmer + toast when the simulator updates so the two panels don't disagree.

Carla (A11y): Keyboard reorder loses focus; announce "Moved to position X of Y" and keep focus stable. Also ensure the shimmer has aria-live text.

Ben (Eng-UX): Plan: read canonical order from the store after the commit, add a short debounce (50-150ms) as a guard, and expose an aria-live region: "Simulator updating to reflect latest rule order".

Maya (PM): Product also wants clearer conflict copy. Replace vague "Conflict" with actionable text, e.g. "Rule conflict: 'geo=EU' overlaps with 'country=DE' — consider narrowing the condition or lowering priority."

Alice (Design): Add a transient "will be #N" badge while dragging and an "Apply order" CTA when manual save is configured. For hosted accounts default to auto-commit.

Ben (Eng-UX): I'll implement store-based capture, shimmer + aria-live, tentative badges, SR announcements, and add unit + a11y e2e tests. PR incoming.

DevExBot: CI queued for branch feature/sim-order-fix (build 2460).

Maya (PM): Thanks team — assigning to Ben for the sprint. Drop any filter/canary+reorder edgecases here.
